name: Ryan W. Baldino
office: City of El Segundo, Member of the City Council

items.text: Ryan W. Baldino, an attorney specializing in construction and real estate litigation, is the Mayor Pro Tem of El Segundo and has served on the City Council since 2022, after 14 years on the Planning Commission.

sentences.text: Ryan W. Baldino, an attorney specializing in construction and real estate litigation, is the Mayor Pro Tem of El Segundo and has served on the City Council since 2022, after 14 years on the Planning Commission.

items.text: He sits on the city's finance subcommittee. He wants to renegotiate the Chevron tax deal to secure funding for at least a decade. He plans to back inclusionary housing laws for low- and moderate-income units, with flexibility for developers. He says he supported a 2023 state law requiring permanent real-time air monitoring at the Hyperion plant.
